definition: dealing with things sensibly and realistically
example: Her pragmatic approach to budgeting saved the project.

definition: having developed certain abilities at an earlier age than usual
example: The precocious toddler was reading chapter books.

definition: a preference or special liking for something
example: He has a predilection for spicy food.

definition: to speak or act evasively; to lie
example: Stop prevaricating and give me a straight answer.

definition: the quality of having strong moral principles; honesty
example: Her probity was beyond question.

definition: to win or regain the favor of; to appease
example: He brought flowers to propitiate his angry neighbor.

definition: giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable
example: Conditions were propitious for the launch.

definition: eager or quick to argue, fight, or disagree
example: His pugnacious style alienated potential allies.

definition: in a state or period of inactivity or dormancy
example: The volcano has been quiescent for a century.

definition: a person who tells anecdotes in a skillful and amusing way
example: Their uncle was a charming raconteur at family gatherings.

definition: the quality of being stubbornly uncooperative
example: His recalcitrance delayed the whole project.

definition: to assign to a lower rank or position; to demote
example: He was relegated to the minor leagues.

definition: to make a forcefully reproachful protest
example: She remonstrated with him about his rudeness.

definition: the quality of being sagacious; keen judgment
example: The diplomat was admired for his sagacity.

definition: most noticeable or important
example: She summarized the salient points of the report.

definition: to authorize or permit; to impose a penalty for
example: The committee sanctioned the new policy.

definition: grimly mocking or cynical
example: She gave a sardonic laugh at his excuse.

definition: brilliantly and excitingly clever or skillful
example: The host delivered a scintillating monologue.

definition: conduct or speech inciting people to rebel against authority
example: He was arrested for sedition after the speech.

definition: tending to induce drowsiness or sleep
example: The soporific lecture put half the room to sleep.

definition: loud and powerful in sound
example: His stentorian voice carried across the hall.

definition: to be miserly or begrudging in giving or spending
example: Don't stint on the spices for this recipe.

definition: loud, harsh, and grating
example: Her strident demands alienated potential allies.

definition: unnecessary, especially through being more than enough
example: Strip away superfluous detail from your essay.

definition: understood or implied without being stated openly
example: They had a tacit agreement not to discuss the matter.
